title: The Last Days
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: The last days are the final stage of redemptive history inaugurated by Christ’s first coming and awaiting His return. Believers live in this present age with Gospel mission, spiritual conflict, and hope in Christ’s appearing.
summary: The last days are the final stage of redemptive history inaugurated by Christ’s first coming and awaiting His return. Believers live in this present age with Gospel mission, spiritual conflict, and hope in Christ’s appearing.
christFocus: Jesus Christ stands at the center of the last days because God has spoken finally in His Son. His death, resurrection, ascension, and promised return define this age and its hope.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Scripture speaks of the last days as the time in which God’s saving plan has reached its decisive fulfillment in Christ. The church is not waiting for redemption to begin; Christ has come, died, risen, and poured out the Spirit.

These last days also include conflict, deception, suffering, and opposition to God. Scripture warns believers not to be surprised by spiritual danger or moral confusion in the present age.

The last days should be understood biblically, not sensationally. Every generation must be awake and faithful, but no generation is given permission to build doctrine on speculation beyond Scripture.

Believers live between the appearing of Christ in grace and His appearing in glory. This calls for mission, endurance, holiness, discernment, and hope.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many people use the language of the last days to create panic or predictions. Others ignore the urgency of the age altogether. Scripture gives a balanced path: sober readiness and faithful obedience.

This doctrine helps believers understand their place in God’s plan. We live after Christ’s finished work and before His return, called to proclaim the Gospel until He comes.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Live as one who belongs to Christ in the last days. Do not be ruled by fear, trends, or speculation. Stay rooted in Scripture, proclaim the Gospel, resist deception, and endure with hope until the Lord appears.
